analyst_view.overall: Brighton (5th of 36, 7 points) host Universitatea Craiova (8th, also 7 points), so a top-eight place is at stake for both. Brighton lost 2-0 at Hull on Sunday and play Newcastle at the weekend, so rotation is likely, with Kadioglu, Wieffer, Hinshelwood, Osman and Kostoulas pushing for starts; Mitoma, Ferguson, Tzimas and Yohanna are out and in the numbers, while Malick Yalcouyé (hurt on Ivory Coast duty, out for a few weeks per Hurzeler) and doubtful Jaouen Hadjam are not. Craiova, top in Romania after a 6-2 win at UTA Arad, have Al-Hamlawi, Baiaram and Cicâldău available, but forward Monday Etim has a muscle injury and Mihnea Rădulescu is not registered, neither of which the numbers list; keeper Isenko's absence is counted. German referee Matthias Jöllenbeck (5.3 cards a game in three on record) is already counted. I keep a small cut on Brighton's attack for rotation.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals, 2.8 of them for Brighton, and already take Mitoma, Ferguson and Tzimas into account. A rotated Brighton side with Newcastle next and Yalcouyé out, plus Craiova's compact back three and the loss of Monday Etim for their counters, point slightly lower, so I go to about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.6 corners, 8.3 of them for Brighton, who should have long spells of possession against a Craiova side that defends deep with wing-backs dropping into a back five. That pattern drives corners whichever Brighton players start, so I stay at 10.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards and already add about 6% for referee Matthias Jöllenbeck, who has shown 5.3 cards a game in his three on record. Craiova will spend long periods defending and pick up the larger share (2.6), which the numbers expect; nothing new here, so I stay at 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots, about 22 for Brighton. Several changes are expected before Newcastle, with younger players like Kostoulas and Osman likely to start and Yalcouyé out, which the numbers can't see, so I trim to about 28.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. A rotated Brighton attack and Craiova without Etim on the break point a touch lower, so I go to about 10.2; it is a small lean because Brighton should still create plenty at home.
